title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 224 ]

blocks.text: Today, many states allow television news report of court trials. They seem to think that covering on television is the best way to inform the public about the court system. But I don't agree with them. A fair trials isn't possible when TV cameras are rolling. Judges, juniors, and witnesses will be distracted by knowing that they are being taped on the local evening news. Many witnesses will not want to appears in a trial on TV. Let's use TV cameras for fictional trials, not real ones.

readingSentences.english: Today, many states allow television news report of court trials.
readingSentences.korean: 오늘날 많은 주에서 법정 재판의 TV 뉴스 보도를 허용하고 있다.

readingSentences.english: They seem to think that covering on television is the best way to inform the public about the court system.
readingSentences.korean: 그들은 TV로 중계하는 것이 법원 시스템에 대해 대중에게 알리는 가장 좋은 방법이라고 생각하는 것 같다.

readingSentences.english: But I don't agree with them.
A fair trials isn't possible when TV cameras are rolling.
readingSentences.korean: TV 카메라가 돌아가고 있을 때는 공정한 재판이 불가능하다.

readingSentences.english: Judges, juniors, and witnesses will be distracted by knowing that they are being taped on the local evening news.
readingSentences.korean: 판사, 배심원, 증인들은 자신들이 지역 저녁 뉴스에 녹화되고 있다는 사실을 알고 주의가 산만해질 것이다.

readingSentences.english: Many witnesses will not want to appears in a trial on TV.
readingSentences.korean: 많은 증인들이 TV 재판에 출석하기를 원하지 않을 것이다.

readingSentences.english: Let's use TV cameras for fictional trials, not real ones.
readingSentences.korean: TV 카메라는 실제 재판이 아닌 가상의 재판을 위해 사용하도록 하자.
